dogecoin.text: I hate myself for jumping in the $doge train. #FOMO a memecoin is driving many people all in and actually the price is soaring high. Is it going to be that high or temporarily high? #dogecoin
But i dont mind buying another stash of $doge when it goes down under 0,00xx just wait for another tweet and we will go to the moon again 😁

With that kind of hype $doge, i expected this meme coin to incline even slowly. I feel bad for everyone investing in high number when it was $ 0,6. I could let it go as it gave my that bullish vibe. (Just my guts, not advice)
I actually converted the entire $doge in my bag 3 days ago as i started seeing a decline in the price. #hodl if you wish, but i converted my entire $doge to $xrp #dogetothemoon #doge #xrp

I support #memecoin and support the serious crypto even more $BTC $ETH $XRP $BNB etc. however, if you are bashing the OG $BTC to promote $DOGE, that is disrespectful to the community. #BNB #Bitcoin #XRP
Isn’t it inevitable with elon keeps on promoting $doge ?
I really enjoy watching $doge plumetting. $btc $bnb $eth just go the deepest pit of the ocean.
